svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Redux, Next.js, Astro, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap. Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express, GraphQL, C# / .NET, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, Python, C. Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Supabase, SQLite. Tools & Other: Git, Docker, Linux, Postman, Webpack, Babel, Caddy, ffmpeg, libvips. Used to build this blog: TypeScript, React, Astro, HTML5, CSS3, Node.js, C# / .NET, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, SQLite, Git, Docker, Linux, Caddy, ffmpeg, libvips.
